verdict.rationale: Rippling documents AI-driven insights inside the product—e.g. 'Use AI to build reports and dashboards on labor cost trends, overtime by location' and a headcount dashboard with a natural-language prompt 'Show me headcount vs plan,' plus AI-powered instant answers for benefits questions. These are first-party marketing claims without independent hands-on verification or detail on breadth/accuracy across the whole platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI insights actually working, broader coverage of AI-generated suggestions beyond time-attendance/benefits (e.g. payroll, HR core), and technical depth on how insights are generated.
